title: PromptPackV0_1
description: JSON sidecar shape for a single Mikage Zenith render brief in bridge format (.md brief + this JSON sidecar). One brief = one entity-track-era binding = one output target.

brief_id.description: e.g. BRIEF_DIGITAL_ASH_MV_V0_1. Must be unique repo-wide.

brief_md_path.description: Repo-relative path to the paired .md brief file. e.g. docs/automation/render_briefs/DIGITAL_ASH_MV_BRIEF_V0_1.md

schema_version.description: Locks this sidecar to v0.1 of the prompt_pack schema.

operator_approval_token.description: Only present once operator explicitly issues OPERATOR_APPROVED = YES with the matching brief_id. Null until then.

source_evidence.description: Section 2 — every document this brief leans on. Anti-Hard-Rule-#1 guard: render briefs must cite the existing canon they inherit from.

canon_references.description: Repo-relative paths to canon files this brief inherits from.

anti_drift_references.description: Repo-relative paths to drift audits / negative prompt locks this brief obeys.

drive_references.description: Optional. Drive file IDs or paths cited.

track_catalog_reference.description: Optional. Path or ID for the TooLost catalog row backing entity_track_binding.track_release_id.

entity_track_binding.description: Section 3 — which entity, which track, which release. Catch-up MV briefs MUST bind to a live track.

entity_id.description: Matches character_workflow/proposals/<entity>.json id field. e.g. mikage_zenith / lora / lyra / commander_lyre / zenith_blade / unbreakable_shield.

secondary_entities.description: Optional. Other entities appearing in this brief (e.g. weapon used by primary entity).

track_release_id_toolost.description: TooLost release ID. Null if brief is not track-bound.

track_launch_arc_number.description: 01–07 = LIVE; 08+ = pending. Null if brief is not track-bound.

track_drop_date.description: ISO 8601 date. Null if brief is not track-bound.

era_tag.description: Section 4 — Timeline Progression Layer era binding (per MIKAGE_V2_5_vs_V1_LOCK_CONFLICT_REPORT.md §3).

era.description: Determines accent palette + backdrop language. V1 = electric violet glitch; V2.5 = crimson #E60000; transition = Mikage Phase 2 only; pre-event = Mikage Phase 1 Imperial Clean.

mikage_phase.description: Only meaningful when entity_id = mikage_zenith. 1 = Imperial Clean, 2 = Fallen/Exile, 3 = Execution/LORA Ownership.

zenith_blade_phase.description: Only meaningful when zenith_blade visible in frame.

visual_intent.description: Section 5 — what the frame is for, narratively + visually.

scene_summary.description: One-sentence summary of what this frame depicts.

mood.description: One-line emotional anchor. e.g. 'silent before the strike', 'fractured but unbroken'.

narrative_beat.description: Optional. Reference to a scene_beat_map entry once that schema lands.

reference_creators.description: Optional. Style anchors from CANON_RESEARCH §4. Allowed: tsutomu_nihei, alberto_mielgo, sun_wolf, naoki_urasawa, makoto_shinkai, tatsuki_fujimoto.

character_state_anchor.description: Default per operator Q-D. Brief overrides only if explicitly declared.

asset_inputs.description: Section 6 — existing repo / Drive assets reused by this brief (catch-up workflow). Empty array allowed for from-scratch renders.

path.description: Repo-relative path, OR 'drive://<drive_id>' for Drive-hosted assets.

role.description: How the asset is used in this brief.

usable_verdict.description: Result of failure-mode test (F1-F4) per drift audit §2.

verdict_source.description: Reference to the audit / report that produced this verdict.

prompt_pack.description: Section 7 — the actual prompts the operator pastes into image / video tool.

primary_prompt.description: Renderer-ready positive prompt block. Should embed era anchors, palette anchors, and explicit anti-drift language.

secondary_prompts.description: Optional. Alternate prompts for multi-shot briefs.

negative_prompt.description: Section 8 — anti-drift. Universal lock from drift audit + brief-specific additions only.

universal_lock_inherited.description: Every brief MUST inherit the universal negative prompt lock. Cannot be false in v0.1.

brief_specific_additions.description: Optional. Extra negative terms scoped to this brief only.

output_target.description: Section 9 — where the rendered output lands once operator renders externally.

output_path.description: Repo-relative path where operator must save the rendered file. e.g. docs/automation/render_briefs/raw/DIGITAL_ASH_MV_KEY_01.png

verification_checklist.description: Section 10 — per-output PASS/FAIL gate Cowork applies post-render before packaging. Must include at minimum F1-F4 failure modes + era tag check + universal negative lock check.

check_id.description: Short ID. Recommended set for v0.1: F1_PLASTIC_READ, F2_FACE_SOFTENING, F3_MECHA_CLUTTER, F4_ERA_BLEED, ERA_TAG_MATCH, NEGATIVE_LOCK_INHERITED.

chua_xac_nhan_fields.description: Section 11 — optional but recommended explicit list of fields the brief cannot fully resolve at draft time. Use this to declare known unknowns; leave absent only when the brief has no unresolved fields.

field_path.description: Dotted path within this sidecar, e.g. prompt_pack.secondary_prompts or entity_track_binding.track_drop_date
